item.title: 47 Years Ago, The Longest NBA Game Ever, That Saw Some Players Play For Both Teams, Ended
item.description: 47 years ago today, an official NBA game between the Nets and Sixers ended, that had started 5 months prior, and had some players play for both teams in that one game for the only time in league history. How? Check it out...

item.title: Karlo Matkovic Was ‘Randomly Selected’ For A Drug Test After His 360 Alley-Oop Slam
item.description: NBA players sometimes are randomly selected for drug tests. Sometimes the ‘randomly selected’ part doesn’t seem to add up. The newest ‘random’ drug test victim? Karlo Matkovic.

item.title: Skip Bayless Questions NBA’s Decision To Rescind Luka Dončić’s 16th Technical
item.description: The NBA’s decision to rescind Luka Dončić’s 16th technical foul has kept the Los Angeles Lakers star on the floor, but it has also reignited debate about consistency, star treatment, and league discipline.

item.title: Gabrielle Union’s Quick Reaction Protects Dwyane Wade During Japan Trip
item.description: A brief moment from Gabrielle Union and Dwyane Wade’s trip to Japan went viral after Union reacted instantly and pulled Wade away from what appeared to be an oncoming bridge structure.

item.title: 57 Years Ago Today, Wes Unseld Became NBA MVP As Rookie
item.description: Fifty-seven years ago today, Wes Unseld etched his name into NBA history by becoming only the second rookie ever to win the league's MVP award.

item.title: Derrick White Leaves No Doubt About His Moon Landing Stance
item.description: Derrick White has now made his position unmistakably clear, saying that he does not believe the United States landed on the moon.

item.title: Scottie Pippen’s Mr. Pibb Spot Turns Old Debate Into Sharp, Self-Aware Comedy
item.description: Scottie Pippen’s new Mr. Pibb commercial works because it is selling more than a soda. It is selling a reputation, a grievance, and a joke all at once.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama Makes His MVP Case Loud And Clear
item.description: Victor Wembanyama is not tiptoeing around the NBA’s MVP conversation. The Spurs star once again openly argued that he belongs at the front of the race and made clear he wants to remove any doubt before the regular season ends.

item.title: Jared McCain Admits There Was A Desire To Prove Sixers Wrong
item.description: After Oklahoma City’s win over Philadelphia, Jared McCain acknowledged that facing his old team came with a natural urge to make a statement, even as he tried to center himself on the bigger goal of helping the Thunder win.

item.title: Darryn Peterson Opens Up About Playing Through Pain After Kansas’ Season Ends
item.description: In the aftermath of Kansas' loss, the bigger takeaway was Darryn Peterson’s admission that much of his year had been shaped by pain, frustration and a fight to simply feel like himself again.

item.title: Stephen A. Smith Leaves Door Open For Lakers To Beat Spurs, Thunder In The Playoffs
item.description: Stephen A. Smith is not picking the Lakers to beat teams like the Oklahoma City Thunder or the San Antonio Spurs in a series, but he’s also not ruling out the possibility of them making real noise given how they’re playing right now..

item.title: NBPA Takes Aim At NBA’s 65-Game Rule After Cade Cunningham Case
item.description: The National Basketball Players Association publicly called for the 65-game rule to be eliminated or at least revised, using Cade Cunningham’s case as its clearest example of how a rigid threshold can undercut a deserving season.

item.title: Evan Turner Picks Luka Doncic As MVP Over Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Victor Wembanyama
item.description: The MVP race is crowded with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Victor Wembanyama in it, but Luka Doncic also has his supporters. Former NBA player Evan Turner is one of them and believes Luka should take home the award this year.

item.title: LeBron James Explains What Made Austin Reaves Stand Out From Day One
item.description: LeBron James has never hidden how much he values feel, creativity and basketball instinct, and his recent comments about Austin Reaves offered a revealing look at what first caught his attention.

item.title: NBA Takes Formal Step Toward Expansion In Las Vegas And Seattle
item.description: The NBA’s long-anticipated expansion push moved into a new phase on Wednesday, when the league’s Board of Governors approved a measure allowing the NBA to formally explore bids and applicants for expansion teams in Las Vegas and Seattle.
